Messages.Author: Cartman
Messages.Body:
1)My Tremere is equipped with a Corpse Minion, and tries to block an action:
does he have to pay the X blood to get X extra intercept at the beginning
of the action, or he can pay blood to gain enough intercept to counter the
stealth played by the opposing vamp after each played action modifier ?

2)Angelica the Canonicus: the same as for the corpse minion

3)Masquerade Enforcement: is it stackable?

Thanx

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Cartman wrote:
>
> 1)My Tremere is equipped with a Corpse Minion, and tries to block an action:
> does he have to pay the X blood to get X extra intercept at the beginning
> of the action, or he can pay blood to gain enough intercept to counter the
> stealth played by the opposing vamp after each played action modifier ?

He can do it at any time during the action, multiple times during the action.

> 2)Angelica the Canonicus: the same as for the corpse minion

Any time, once only (card text)

> 3)Masquerade Enforcement: is it stackable?

Yes. See the online card text.
